question: The female devotee, Andal belonged to which part of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Southern**__.

__
 
• **Andal was a woman saint of South India**__.

 __
 
• She is one of the twelve** Alvar saints**.
 
• She is called** 'Mira of the South'**.
 
• She was born in Vikram No. 770.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Andal **has composed tw**o texts-** Tiruppavai, **Nachiyar Tirumoli**

 
 
• **She** also has a **famous name** **'Kaude'.**
